primary_endpoint.measure: paired absolute success-rate difference in percentage points
primary_endpoint.selection_basis: Prior diagnostic210 outcomes and camera ablations only

secondary_endpoints: per-category results, descriptive and without multiplicity-adjusted claims

clean_retention.criterion_for_basic_retention_phrase: Both paired differences and their95% cluster interval lower bounds >= -3pp. Otherwise show observed changes and state uncertainty or degradation.
clean_retention.scope: Exploratory tolerance criterion, not a powered noninferiority trial

efficiency.frequency_claim: Use measured simulator request-to-request cycles, identify R/N setting; never call R/latency closed-loop feedback frequency or claim physical robot Hz.
efficiency.preferred_N_comparison: R5,N3 versus R5,N10 changes only denoising steps; report paired success difference with interval.

checkpoint_selection: Always step4999 for planned5000steps; no heldout selection or tuning
limitations: Fixed perturbation variants on the same40 base tasks
